mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS close_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_voucher v WHERE v.period = p.period) AS voucher_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_voucher v WHERE v.period = p.period AND v.status <> 'POSTED') AS unposted_count FROM fin_period p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.close_by ORDER BY p.period DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_period SET voucher_seq = voucher_seq + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE period = #{period} AND status = 'OPEN'
